_note: Settings for the WC6 KPI dashboard. Safe to commit: no secrets or contact data here.

ticket_holder_rule._how: Paid (completed/paid) order containing a product whose name starts with ticket_product_name_prefix, order amount >= min_paid_amount (drops $1 tests). Contacts with comp_tag and no paid order count as comps from campaign start.

workflow_name_rules._how: New WC6 workflows: names matching promote/post_ticket are labelled automatically; any other name containing WC6 is flagged in the refresh output, never guessed.

thresholds._how: A number turns red when it goes past these (percent).

summary_rules._how: The three summary lines are picked by these fixed rules every refresh (no AI).

headline._how: New paid tickets yesterday vs the average of the N days before it. 'In line' = within the tolerance.

win._how: 1) a send from yesterday with click rate >= click_multiple x its campaign's average (min_sends+); else 2) the upsell with the highest take rate; else 3) best open rate among sends with min_sends+.

watch._how: The metric furthest past its red line in thresholds (to date). If none: 'Nothing needs attention today.'

_refresh_days: Daily GitHub runs re-read only the last refresh_days days from GHL and keep older days from data.json.
_update_times_et: When fresh numbers land on the page (Eastern). The GitHub Action starts 30 minutes earlier (cron in .github/workflows/daily-refresh.yml).

ghl_links._how: Fixed links from the Unsub/Opt-out and Bounce/Failed counts into GoHighLevel. Set once by hand; the scheduled run never changes them. Workflow links open the workflow: turn on Stats view (chart icon) and click Unsubscribed, Bounced or Failed on a step to see those contacts. For SMS opt-outs, paste a saved Smart List URL (or leave null).
